tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend. This was decided by the user, and no later decision has changed it.

cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
tool_input.description: Write the TLS backend policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, that the user made that decision, and that nothing later has changed it. It doesn't mention the retired alternative.

The decision comes from Muninn record #14 ("Let's use rustls instead"), which is current. Record #32 ("https everywhere") is a separate policy that doesn't name a backend, so I left it out.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead.

Muninn also reported a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That didn't affect this task, but a hook may be timing out. `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` has the details.
